hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push' && echo 'Reminder: check deployment status with: gh run watch --exit-status' || true
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'git (reset --hard|clean -f|push --force|checkout \.)' && echo 'Blocked: dangerous git operation. Please confirm with user first.' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0

hooks.prompt: Review all code changes in this session. If there is no change, exit. Otherwise, run typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit in apps/web) and review the git diff for bugs, type errors, race conditions, and missing edge cases. Report any issues found.
